Profile Diolamine methoxycinnamate, a compounded substituted cinna- mate, is a sunscreen (p.1576) with actions similar to those of oc- tinoxate (p.1608). It is effective against UVB light (for defini- tions, see p.1580). Preparations Proprietary Preparations some preparations are listed in Part 3. Dioxybenzone (USAN, rINN) Benzofenon-8; Benzophenone-8; Dioxibenzona; Dioxybenzon- um; NSC-56769. 2,2′-Dihydroxy-4-methoxybenzophenone. Диоксибензон C14H12O4 = 244.2. CAS — 131-53-3. Pharmacopoeias. In US. USP 31 (Dioxybenzone). A yellow powder. Practically insolu- ble in water; freely soluble in alcohol and in toluene. Store in air- tight containers. Protect from light. Profile Dioxybenzone, a substituted benzophenone, is a sunscreen (p.1576) with actions similar to those of oxybenzone (p.1608). It is effective against UVB and some UVA light (for definitions, see p.1580). Preparations USP 31: Dioxybenzone and Oxybenzone Cream. Proprietary Preparations some preparations are listed in Part 3.
